basic_info.description: A wall of floor-to-ceiling glass frames sweeping, front-row views of Alcatraz, the Bay, and Marin from this sophisticated 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom condominium atop Russian Hill. Spanning 970 sq. ft. (per graphic artist), the residence offers an airy, open floor plan with generous space for living, dining, and a dedicated work/desk area. The updated kitchen is equipped with high-end appliances and opens seamlessly to the main living space, all oriented toward the captivating water vistas. Double sliding doors lead to a protected terrace, offering an exceptional indoor/outdoor experience ideal for year-round enjoyment, including a prime perch for the Blue Angels. The spacious bedroom features full water views, a large walk-in closet with built-ins, and an updated bathroom. Located on a flat block, The Summit is a landmark, full-service luxury high-rise designed by architect Joseph Eichler offering 24-hour security, on-site management, and deeded parking. Moments from the vibrant shops and restaurants of Russian Hill, North Beach, Nob Hill, and Pacific Heights.
